beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So the rebel fell. This is the story of what he lost, what he kept — and the question everyone asks sooner or later: why does God allow a devil at all?

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Lucifer. The name means light-bearer. Son of the morning. Not a monster from a pit — one of the family. Brilliant. Trusted. Until he wanted the throne more than the family.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus said that as an eyewitness. He watched it happen. And notice what the fall cost: not existence — position. The presence of the Father. His glory. And one thing more, forever: he will never have a body.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Every baby ever born receives the thing he forfeited. Remember that the next time he whispers that your body is shameful, or worthless, or a prison. He would trade anything for one.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: For he seeketh that all men might be miserable like unto himself.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Now the hard question. If God is all-powerful, and all-good — why keep a devil around? Why not just turn him off? God answered that question directly. Listen:

beats.speaker: father
beats.text: And it must needs be that the devil should tempt the children of men, or they could not be agents unto themselves; for if they never should have bitter they could not know the sweet.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Or they could not be agents unto themselves. There it is, from God's own mouth. Freedom is not real if no is impossible. A world with no tempter is a world with no choice — and that was the devil's plan. God refused to defeat him by becoming him.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So hold this straight: God did not create evil. He created freedom — knowing it could say no, knowing His brightest would say it first, and knowing what the repair would cost. The Lamb was chosen before the devil ever fell.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: For it must needs be, that there is an opposition in all things.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: No opposition, no growth. No resistance, no strength. The road where you become like Jesus runs uphill on purpose — and every time you tell the devil no, you become more of what God sent you here to become.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So when temptation comes for you today, remember what is actually behind it. Not a rival god. A beaten, bodiless, desperate former brother whose only remaining power is a voice. And you have beaten his voice before.

card.speaker: narrator
card.text: He has no body, no future, and no power over you but a voice. And you have beaten his voice before.
